intent: Export the unique nontrivial order-2 character of Z_12_v1 (parity character) as a typed strict object, and record that it is invariant under Aut(Z_12_v1). This is a gauge-robust ingredient for the typed AX20/T162 lane; it does not imply theta export nor QW-2191 discharge.

properties.aut_z12_invariance_reason: All units u in (Z/12Z)^× are odd, so (u*k mod 2) = (k mod 2).
